note: One list of quote-check cases, kept identical in two repos: service-manual-chat-backend at app/ask/quote_check_cases.json and service-manual-ui at tests/unit/server/ai-ask/quote-check-cases.json. Change both or neither. Each case gives the page as its markdown source, the quote as the model wrote it, and the outcome the check must return: ok, not_found (a word changed, added or removed), partial (the words are on the page but the quote starts or stops part way through a sentence) stitched (the words are on the page but the match takes in a table cell and something outside it, another cell or the text around the table, so they were never one sentence; a quote may still run across whole list items, as the four incident steps do) or empty (no words left once markup is removed). The golden set defines an exact quote as words and their order matching the source; spacing, line breaks and surrounding punctuation do not count.

pages.using-data:
## What the conditions mean

For personal data, the DPIA route is for a service you are building to
process it, not a way to paste it into an everyday tool. For everyday use,
remove personal data first.
pages.incident:
## What to do
  • Stop using the AI tool immediately.
  • Do not delete or change anything. The people handling the incident need to see clearly what happened.
  • Tell your line manager and your team's information asset owner. Give a short description of what happened and what data was involved.
  • Report it through Defra's security incident process so the information security team can assess it.
You must report it if you have:
  • put OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE content into a public consumer AI tool
  • put any personal data into any AI tool
pages.ethics: If your tool significantly influences a decision with a public effect, or interacts directly with the public, you must publish a record in the [Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard (ATRS)](https://www.gov.uk/government/collections/algorithmic-transparency-recording-standard-hub). This is mandatory across central government.
pages.choosing:
You can use any AI tool, as long as you follow the rules on what data you put into it. The status tells you how established a tool is at Defra, not whether you are allowed to use it:
  • Using. Used by teams across Defra today.
  • Trialling. Being trialled with some teams before wider use.
pages.markdown-emphasis:
Three statuses:

- **Using.** Used by teams across Defra today.
- *Trialling.* Being trialled with some teams before wider use.

1. Check the radar first.
2. Then check the data rules.
pages.links: Read the tools radar. Then choose a tool. See [Travelling securely]() before you go. Book through [the portal](https://intranet.example/book) first.
